name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois discovered her passion for motorsport while catering a small event at a local karting track. The thrill of the races and the vibrant atmosphere ignited a desire to combine her culinary skills with the excitement of the sport.  Before Tolman Motorsport, she honed her catering skills in several Parisian restaurants, learning to manage high-pressure environments and deliver exceptional service under tight deadlines. 

At Tolman, Sophie is responsible for ensuring the team and guests are well-fed and energized throughout race weekends. She meticulously plans menus, sources high-quality ingredients, and manages a small team to deliver delicious and nutritious meals. Her adaptable approach ensures that dietary requirements and preferences are always met, contributing to the overall well-being and performance of the team. What sets Sophie apart is her ability to create a welcoming and comforting atmosphere, even amidst the intense pressure of competition. Her attention to detail, combined with her genuine care for the team's well-being, makes her an invaluable asset.

physical.description: Sophie is of average height with a warm, welcoming smile.

quirks: Always has a selection of artisanal cheeses on hand.
Insists on using fresh herbs, even if it means sourcing them from unusual locations.
Whistles French pop songs while preparing meals.
